say:2:1221105001:1.text: There's a letter inside! With a boy's wish! Does the sea really grant wishes?
say:2:1221105001:1.source_cn: 漂流瓶里居然是一封许愿信！\n大海真的会实现这些心愿吗？

say:3:1221105002:1.text: Most tales about kids having their wishes come true if they behave are made up by adults.
say:3:1221105002:1.source_cn: 大部分让小孩乖乖听话，等待心愿被实现的故事，都是大人编...

say:4:1221105003:1.text: Still, my heart aches for the boy who penned this letter... Navigating through the fog is no simple task. His father and brother might never make it home...
say:4:1221105003:1.source_cn: 不过，写这封信的小男孩也好可怜……在迷雾中探索航道可不...

say:5:1221105004:1.text:
Chippy thinks so too...
How about we fulfill his wish?
say:5:1221105004:1.source_cn: 满满也这样觉得……\n要不，我们来帮他实现愿望吧！

choice_prompt:6:1221105004.text:
Chippy thinks so too...
How about we fulfill his wish?
choice_prompt:6:1221105004.source_cn: 满满也这样觉得……\n要不，我们来帮他实现愿望吧！

say:7:1221105005:1.text: That's right! Protecting a child's dream is part of my duty as a knight!
say:7:1221105005:1.source_cn: 没错！骑士也应该守护孩子们的童真美梦！

say:8:1221105006:1.text: We can easily catch a <style="highlight">rainbow snapper</style>, but we need to make sure he doesn't know it's from us.

say:9:1221105007:1.text: Hmm... Maybe we could put the fish inside the floating bottle and leave it on his doorstep. That way, he'll think that his wish has been granted by the sea!
say:9:1221105007:1.source_cn: 嗯……也许可以把幻彩鲷装在漂流瓶里，放到他家门口。这样...

say:10:1221105008:1.text: That's brilliant! Chippy, you've gotten smarter!
say:10:1221105008:1.source_cn: 这个办法不错！满满，你变聪明了~

choice:6:1:2.text: Do you want to get him a rainbow snapper?
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你想送一条幻彩鲷给他？

choice:6:1:2.female: Do you want to get him a rainbow snapper?
